verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API, and its endpoints carry a version prefix (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`), so a versioned API exists. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, or migration guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning/changelog documentation, sunset/notice timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
